lines.text: Two friends. Both invest one hundred dollars a month.
Alex starts at twenty. Sam waits until thirty.
Both keep going until sixty-seven, at ten percent a year.
Alex puts in just twelve thousand dollars more than Sam.
At sixty-seven, Sam has four hundred thirty-five thousand.
Alex has one point one five million.
Ten years of waiting cost Sam over seven hundred thousand dollars.
The best time to start was yesterday. The second best is today.
